content.title: Usher, Chris Brown join forces for surprise tour
content.text: Updated April 10, 2026, 1:49 p.m. ETR&B enthusiasts will love this. Chris Brown and Usher are joining forces on the road.Dubbed the R&B, Raymond and Brown Tour, both singers shared the news in a joint Instagram post on April 10. It includes a promotional video of Usher and Brown riding motorcycles to a venue and entering an elevator."It's time," Usher says. "Hell yeah," Brown responds before walking on stage in front of a screaming crowd.No additional details were provided. The news comes after Brown's Breezy Bowl XX tour and Usher's Past Present Future tour and his popular Las Vegas residency.Internet reacts to Usher, Brown tourFor years, fans have called on Usher and Brown to participate in a hit-for-hit Verzuz battle, sparking major debate online. The tour unleashed immediate mixed reactions on social media."Chris Brown and Usher going on tour…. Take allllll my money please," one fan said.Another person chimed in, "Chris Brown and Usher tour is GENIUS!!! Sell out every night.""Usher and Chris Brown going on tour is crazy to me personally," another person wrote.Someone else added, "The way that people are excited for the Usher and Chris Brown tour... I am living in a whole different reality than so many people."The pair has collaborated a few timesThe singers have collaborated a few times throughout their careers. One of their most popular is Brown's 2014 song "New Flame" featuring Usher and rap emcee Rick Ross.The accompanying video includes Usher's now-famous glitch dance move, which became a trend on TikTok two years ago."One of my favorite music collaborations where I was a feature on the song and the video was Chris Brown's 'New Flame,'" Usher shared with his fans on Instagram. "Everything about it.. the dance, everything."Last year, Usher generated buzz online when he hopped on Brown and Bryson Tiller's "It Depends (The Remix)." The song samples his 1997 hit "Nice & Slow."This week, Brown also announced an upcoming album set to be released on May 8.This story has been updated with new information.Taylor Ardrey is a news reporter for USA TODAY. You can reach her at tardrey@usatodayco.com.
